titles.title: Transportation Relief for Servicemembers at Remote Locations Act of 2026
Transportation Relief for Servicemembers at Remote Locations Act of 2026

A bill to amend section 453 of title 37, United States Code, to provide for the reimbursement of costs of long commutes for members of the Armed Forces assigned to remote or isolated installations in areas without affordable housing.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Armed Services.
